name: Better Hitbox Trail
description: more options and better hitbox trail

trail-length.name: Trail Length
trail-length.description: Number of recent hitbox positions to retain (maximum 1024).

trail-capture-rate.name: Trail Capture Rate
trail-capture-rate.description: Number of regular hitbox positions recorded per second. Clicks and releases are recorded regardless of this setting.

batch-layer-overlap.name: Batch Layer Overlap
batch-layer-overlap.description: Draws hitbox outlines grouped by layer type across the whole trail instead of the default per-position overlap.

hitbox-between-frames.name: Hitbox Between Frames
hitbox-between-frames.description: When using CBF or CBS, this also records a hitbox position at the exact sub-tick moment a click/release occurs. Turn off to only record hitbox positions on regular game ticks, since sub-tick hitboxes aren't actual collision points.

blue-hitbox-color-clicks.name: Blue Hitbox Color Clicks
blue-hitbox-color-clicks.description: Applies the Click and Release colors to the blue hitbox when clicked. (Follows the 'Color Clicks' and 'Color when Held' popup settings.)

circle-hitbox-color-clicks.name: Circle Hitbox Color Clicks
circle-hitbox-color-clicks.description: Applies the Click and Release colors to the circle hitbox when clicked. (Follows the 'Color Clicks' and 'Color when Held' popup settings.)

rotation-color-clicks.name: Rotation Color Clicks
rotation-color-clicks.description: Applies the Click and Release colors to the rotation hitbox when clicked. (Follows the 'Color Clicks' and 'Color when Held' popup settings.)

square-hitbox-color.name: Square Hitbox Color
square-hitbox-color.description: Color of the main square hitbox outline.

blue-hitbox-color.name: Blue Hitbox Color
blue-hitbox-color.description: Color of the internal blue hitbox outline.

circle-hitbox-color.name: Circle Hitbox Color
circle-hitbox-color.description: Color of the circle hitbox outline.

player-rotation-color.name: Rotation Hitbox Color
player-rotation-color.description: Color of the rotation hitbox outline.

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: Master opacity multiplier, shown as the single Opacity control in the in-game settings popup. Multiplied with every individual opacity setting below.

square-hitbox-opacity.name: Square Opacity
square-hitbox-opacity.description: Opacity of the square hitbox outline, multiplied with the main opacity setting.

blue-hitbox-opacity.name: Blue Opacity
blue-hitbox-opacity.description: Opacity of the internal blue hitbox, multiplied with the main opacity setting.

circle-hitbox-opacity.name: Circle Opacity
circle-hitbox-opacity.description: Opacity of the circle hitbox, multiplied with the main opacity setting.

player-rotation-opacity.name: Rotation Hitbox Opacity
player-rotation-opacity.description: Opacity of the rotation hitbox outline, multiplied with the main opacity setting.

thickness.name: Thickness
thickness.description: Master thickness multiplier, shown as the single Thickness control in the in-game settings popup. Multiplied with every individual thickness setting below (all thickness settings adjust inward only).

square-hitbox-thickness.name: Square Thickness
square-hitbox-thickness.description: Outline thickness of the square hitbox at normal size (Wave mode has its own separate setting below).

blue-hitbox-thickness.name: Blue Thickness
blue-hitbox-thickness.description: Outline thickness of the blue hitbox at normal size (Wave mode has its own separate setting below).

circle-hitbox-thickness.name: Circle Thickness
circle-hitbox-thickness.description: Outline thickness of the circle hitbox at normal size (Wave mode has its own separate setting below).

player-rotation-thickness.name: Rotation Thickness
player-rotation-thickness.description: Outline thickness of the rotation hitbox at normal size (Wave mode has its own separate setting below).

mini-square-hitbox-thickness.name: Mini Square Thickness
mini-square-hitbox-thickness.description: Outline thickness of the square hitbox at mini size (Wave mode has its own separate setting below).

mini-blue-hitbox-thickness.name: Mini Blue Thickness
mini-blue-hitbox-thickness.description: Outline thickness of the blue hitbox at mini size (Wave mode has its own separate setting below).

mini-circle-hitbox-thickness.name: Mini Circle Thickness

player-rotation-mini-thickness.name: Mini Rotation Thickness
player-rotation-mini-thickness.description: Outline thickness of the rotation hitbox at mini size (Wave mode has its own separate setting below).

wave-square-hitbox-thickness.name: Wave Square Thickness
wave-square-hitbox-thickness.description: Outline thickness of the square hitbox at normal size in wave mode.

wave-mini-square-hitbox-thickness.description: Outline thickness of the square hitbox at mini size in wave mode.
